fullPassage: A particularly powerful way in which human beings adapt and adjust to their circumstances is by changing behaviors in light of the consequences that they yield. For instance, a child who gets praised by her teacher for doing an exercise correctly is likely to continue doing the exercise in that way. A dancer who feels that a particular conditioning exercise is not giving any results is likely to give that exercise up in favor of another one that seems more promising. In general, we tend to do things that bring us some kind of benefit or act in ways that help us avoid some kind of problem, discomfort, or disadvantage. We also tend to do fewer things (or stop doing things) that lead to problems, discomfort, or disadvantages, and we tend to avoid acting in ways that do not bring any benefit or reward.

det.korean: 인간이 행동을 변화시키는 방식은 그 행동이 가져오는 결과에 비추어(in light of the consequences)이다.

questions.passage: A particularly powerful way in which human beings adapt and adjust to their circumstances is by changing behaviors in light of the consequences that they yield. For instance, a child who gets praised by her teacher for doing an exercise correctly is likely to continue doing the exercise in that way. A dancer who feels that a particular conditioning exercise is not giving any results is likely to <u>give that exercise up in favor of another one that seems more promising</u>. In general, we tend to do things that bring us some kind of benefit or act in ways that help us avoid some kind of problem, discomfort, or disadvantage. We also tend to do fewer things (or stop doing things) that lead to problems, discomfort, or disadvantages, and we tend to avoid acting in ways that do not bring any benefit or reward.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 give that exercise up in favor of another one that seems more promising이 함축하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: '효과 없는 운동을 포기하고 더 유망해 보이는 다른 운동을 택한다'는 것은, 결과가 없는 행동을 중단하고 더 나은 결과를 기대할 수 있는 행동으로 전환한다는 의미.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 능력 한계 인정 + 운동 포기 — 운동 자체를 포기하는 것이 아니라 다른 운동으로 대체(in favor of another one)

❌ ② 더 쉬운 운동 + 노력 최소화 — 쉬운 것이 아닌 '더 유망한(more promising)' 것을 선택

✅ ③ 효과 없는 행동 버리고 + 더 나은 결과 기대되는 행동 선택 — give up(포기) + in favor of another one that seems more promising(더 유망해 보이는 다른 것) 정확히 함축 ←정답

❌ ④ 다른 사람 추천 무조건 따름 — 타인의 추천이 아닌 자신의 판단에 의한 선택
det.tip: give up = 포기하다. in favor of = ~을 선호하여. promising = 유망한, 전망이 좋은
